title: Critical path to a Special Education classroom
intro: Four years ago I was an ADHD coach with a business degree. Here is the exact path I'm walking to become a Mild/Moderate Special Education teacher in Marana, Arizona — and how far along each step is.

milestones.title: Apply to a Master's in Special Education
milestones.summary: Apply to an Arizona EPP that leads to Mild/Moderate K–12 certification and can be stacked with Arizona Teachers Academy funding.

tasks.label: Research Arizona EPP options (ASU, NAU, U of A, GCU)
Compare ASU vs NAU M.Ed. programs in writing
Submit ASU M.Ed. Special Education (Teacher Certification) application
File FAFSA for the award year

evidence.label: ASU vs NAU M.Ed. comparison note

milestones.title: Pass the NES/AEPA Special Education 601
milestones.summary: State subject-knowledge exam required for the SPED certification area on the Alternative Teaching Certificate. Passing it early unlocks the hire.

tasks.label: Build a study system in Obsidian
Build an 80-question practice quiz with grading
Score 80%+ on a full practice run

milestones.title: Get hired by MUSD as a SPED teacher of record
milestones.summary: Use the alternative pathway: approved EPP enrollment → Alternative Teaching Certificate → hired as teacher of record while finishing the program.

tasks.label: Substitute certificate application (foot in the door)
Get admitted to an approved EPP → request enrollment verification letter
Apply to ADE for the Alternative Teaching Certificate
First day as teacher of record

milestones.title: Finish the master's program in the classroom
milestones.summary: Complete coursework and the internship/student teaching requirement, ideally in my own classroom as the teacher of record.

tasks.label: Complete internship / supervised teaching in own classroom
Pass Professional Knowledge exam + US/AZ Constitutions requirement

milestones.title: Earn the Arizona Standard Professional SPED certificate
milestones.summary: Convert from the alternative/intern certificate to the full Standard Professional Mild/Moderate K–12 certificate and keep growing in the classroom.

tasks.label: Apply to ADE for Standard Professional Certificate (Mild/Moderate K–12)

tests.name: NES/AEPA Special Education 601
tests.note: 7 of 8 competencies have study notes; 80-question practice bank built.

tests.name: AEPA/NES Elementary Education Subtest I (NT102)
tests.note: 4 competency notes written (phonics, reading, writing, social studies, geography).

tests.name: AEPA/NES Elementary Education Subtest II (NT103)
tests.note: 2 competency notes written (life science, earth & space science).
